question: Can you provide the number of distinct active and closed bike share stations for each year 2013 and 2014?
sql:
SELECT 
    yr as year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as closed_count
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT start_station_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_time) as yr
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips`
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_time) IN (2013, 2014)
) t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_stations` s 
    ON t.start_station_id = s.station_id
GROUP BY yr
ORDER BY yr
